# Exact versions of the CPU export and training tools that action.yml installs
# for the build workflow's browser-worker parity job, which gates every Pages
# deploy, and for the neural workflow's trainer tests. Every package that
# install resolves is pinned, so a new PyPI release reaches CI only through a
# reviewed Dependabot pull request. PyTorch is pinned in action.yml instead:
# it comes from PyTorch's CPU index, not PyPI.
flatbuffers==25.12.19
maturin==1.15.0
ml_dtypes==0.6.0
numpy==2.5.3
onnx==1.23.0
onnxruntime==1.30.0
packaging==26.3
protobuf==7.36.2
typing_extensions==4.16.0
